1.en: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?
1.tj: هَلْ أَتَـٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَـٰشِيَةِ ١

2.en: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,
2.tj: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَـٰشِعَةٌ ٢

4.en: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.

5.en: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.

6.ar: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍۢ
6.en: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
6.tj: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍ ٦

7.ar: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍۢ
7.en: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.
7.tj: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍ ٧

8.en: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.
8.tj: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاعِمَةٌ ٨

11.en: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.
11.tj: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَـٰغِيَةً ١١

12.en: Within it is a flowing spring.

13.en: Within it are couches raised high

17.ar: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
17.en: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
17.tj: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ ١٧

18.en: And at the sky - how it is raised?
18.tj: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ ١٨

19.en: And at the mountains - how they are erected?

20.en: And at the earth - how it is spread out?

21.en: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.
21.tj: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ ٢١

22.en: You are not over them a controller.

23.en: However, he who turns away and disbelieves -
23.tj: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ ٢٣

24.en: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.

25.en: Indeed, to Us is their return.
25.tj: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ ٢٥

26.en: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
26.tj: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم ٢٦
